title: In the fifth episode, Carla Ferradini, who is doing her Master’s in physics at ETH, talks about the importance of prioritising your time to avoid burnout.
main_content:
Main article: In the fifth episode, Carla Ferradini, who is doing her Master’s in physics at ETH, talks about the importance of prioritising your time to avoid burnout.

Advice for students: ETH Zurich offers advice centres for (virtually) any situation that may arise during your studies.
